name: Kettle Tea Making Robot Skills
description: Parametric skills for an electric-kettle tea making task with a UR5 + Robotiq gripper. Mirrors the cuboid_manipulation skill style: the robot controller is the `program_executor` ROS 2 node in ur5_curobo_control, and each skill maps to a program file under ur5_curobo_control/programs/, invoked via the load-then-execute sequence: (1) set ROS 2 parameters `program_file` and `program_args` on the executor node, (2) call service `/program_executor/load_program` (std_srvs/Trigger), (3) call service `/program_executor/execute_program` (std_srvs/Trigger). A single parametric `pick_and_place_items.prog` moves any key item from storage to its workplace pose in the working area using keyword args (`object=...`, `destination=...`). The robot brings the water bottle from storage to the working area but does NOT pour — the human always pours the water into the kettle. A dedicated kettle program closes the lid and turns the kettle on. The robot CANNOT open the kettle lid — the human does that to signal intent to make tea.

parameters.program_file: string — absolute path or basename of the .prog file under ur5_curobo_control/programs/

skills.name: Move to Named Position
skills.description: Move the robot to a specific named joint configuration or position (e.g. Home, safe, a storage or workspace pose).

name.description: The name of the position to move to

skills.name: Pick and Place Item
skills.description: One-shot pick-and-place of a key item from storage to its workplace pose in the working area, transiting via the safe pose. Use the `item` keyword to select which object to move and `destination` to choose where to drop it. The robot only brings items to the working area — the human handles everything in the cup (adding the tea bag, pouring water, adding milk, stirring).

item.description: Item id to pick from storage; must match an object in initial_scene.json. Sugar is excluded (no perception monitor — human-handled).

destination.description: Named drop pose — the item's own `<item>_workplace` in the working area. Each item has its own workplace pose (items can't share a drop spot).

skills.name: Return Item to Storage
skills.description: Cleanup counterpart of pick_and_place_item: once the tea is prepared, take items the robot brought out back from the working area to storage, using the same parametric pick-and-place program with the poses reversed. Only items with a perception monitor are listed (milk_container, tea_bag, cup, biscuits) so the robot can confirm each return; the spoon is excluded (no perception) and is the human's responsibility. Triggers after the prepare_tea step completes; the BT returns one eligible item per tick as the robot frees up.

item.description: Item id to return to storage from the working area. Limited to perception-tracked items so the move can be verified.

destination.description: Named storage drop pose. Each item returns to its own `<item>_storage` pose.

skills.name: Bring Water Bottle
skills.description: Pick the water bottle from storage and bring it to the human in the working area. The robot only delivers the bottle — the human always pours the water into the kettle. Uses the same parametric pick-and-place program with the water bottle as the object.

skills.name: Return Water Bottle to Storage
skills.description: Cleanup counterpart of bring_water_bottle: once the water has been poured into the kettle and the kettle has been switched on, the bottle is no longer needed, so the robot takes it from the working area back to storage. Uses the same parametric pick-and-place program with the bring_water_bottle poses reversed. The water bottle has a perception monitor (water_bottle_location), so the robot can confirm the return. Becomes eligible after the close_lid_and_turn_on step, letting the robot tidy up the bottle while the kettle boils.

skills.name: Close Kettle Lid and Turn On
skills.description: Single program that closes the kettle lid and then switches the kettle on to start boiling. Requires water in the kettle with the lid still open. The robot can close the lid (but cannot open it). After turning on, the blue LED stays on while it heats and turns off when the water has boiled.

skills.name: Stop Program
skills.description: Halt the currently executing program immediately.

skills.name: Wait
skills.description: Wait for a specified duration or until the human signals readiness (e.g. while the kettle boils).
